jobs.title: Office Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
Weiss Asset Management (WAM), a Boston-based investment firm, is seeking an Office Coordinator to join a dynamic team focused on office operations and employee experience. Successful applicants will be service-oriented self-starters willing to contribute to all aspects of the firm. We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic, excellent communication and organizational skills, and a sharp eye for detail.

Previous experience in office management or hospitality is required. The ideal candidate takes pride in maintaining a high-quality employee experience and is comfortable owning responsibilities end-to-end within a collaborative team environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute day-to-day office processes and services that support a productive, organized, and welcoming work environment.

  • Greet clients and visitors and deliver front-office hospitality services, ensuring a consistently professional and welcoming experience.

  • Assist with travel booking, meeting coordination, and event logistics.

  • Maintain a tidy and organized office environment, managing essential day-to-day upkeep tasks.

  • Restock supplies and manage lunch setup to support the smooth running of daily office needs.

  • Coordinate with Head of Facilities on office services, including maintenance, vendor management and building relationships.

  • Support ph

jobs.title: Summer 2028 Internship Interest Form
jobs.description_text:
Please note: applications for the Summer 2028 Internship are not yet open. This form is not an application, and you’ll need to apply when applications officially open this winter.

In the meantime, share your interest with our team ahead of the formal recruiting process by submitting your resume and a bit about yourself. You’ll be among the first to know when applications open, and we’ll share more about the program as recruiting gets closer.

 

 

Weiss Asset Management (WAM), a Boston-based investment firm, invites applications for our Summer 2028 Investment Analyst Internships. As a summer analyst at WAM, you will collaborate closely with our investment team, which invests globally in equities, derivatives, and fixed income through fundamental and quantitative strategies.

WAM offers two recruiting tracks, both of which lead to the same summer program:

  • The fundamental process evaluates research skills and fundamental analysis. Applications are expected to open in December 2026. 
  • The quantitative process emphasizes skills like coding, statistics, and game theory. Applications are expected to open in February 2027.

As a multi-strategy firm without a traditional pod structure, interns gain exposure to both fundamental and quantitative approaches

jobs.title: Construction Management Internship – Spring 2027
jobs.description_text:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

Enterprise Customer Success Managers empower providers to maximize the value of Zocdoc and play a critical role in advancing some of our most important customer relationships. You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

jobs.title: Mechanical Drafter & Configuration Mgmt Specialist
jobs.description_text: About Trakka Systems Trakka Systems is a global leader in the design, development, and manufacture of mission-critical vision, surveillance, and situational awareness solutions for airborne, maritime, and land-based operations. For more than 25 years, Trakka has delivered innovative technologies including advanced gyro-stabilized imaging systems, EO/IR sensor platforms, high-intensity searchlights, mission management and mapping software, counter-UAS solutions, and integrated surveillance systems that support defense, law enforcement, border security, search and rescue, utility, and special mission operators around the world. Trakka Systems is a member of the Acron Technologies platform of specialized companies that innovate to create safer skies and protect lives. Trakka Systems is seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Drafter & Configuration Management Specialist to serve as the bridge between engineering design and controlled documentation. This role owns three interconnected responsibilities: producing and maintaining engineering drawings and 3D models in SolidWorks, driving the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) process from creation through approval, and managing the company's part number (PN) system. The ideal candidate combines strong technical drafting skills with the organizational discipline to keep product documentation accurate, released, and traceable. jobs.title: Senior Accounting Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Senior Accounting Specialist is responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the organization's financial records. This role performs complex accounting tasks, including, journal entries, account reconciliations, month-end and year-end close processes, and may support ad hoc financial analysis and special projects. The Senior Accounting Specialist ensures compliance with GAAP and internal policies, supports audits, and may assist in budgeting and forecasting activities. This position collaborates cross-functionally with other departments to support overall financial health and decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description_text: Mountain View, CA | AI Fund | Full-time AI Fund is a venture studio founded by Dr. Andrew Ng in 2017. We build AI companies from the ground up with corporate partners, investors, and elite founders, backed by a fund from top-tier global corporations and VC firms. Our purpose is to build AI companies that move humanity forward. Our Engineer in Residence (EIR) program puts a hands-on GenAI builder on an idea for 12 weeks to test it with real users. The strongest go on to found the company, and that is the only way AI Fund deploys capital: every company we fund starts with an EIR hire. The person in this role will own full-cycle recruiting for EIRs and for AI Fund's own team, from first conversation to signed offer. We're rethinking how recruiting works now that AI exists. We're after 5x improvements, not 5% gains, and the recruiter in this seat helps build that. Base salary, plus carry, plus benefits.

The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. jobs.title: Growth Development Representative
jobs.description_text: The Growth Development Representative (GDR) drives Aledade's cohort-driven 1:many demand motion at the account level for Core accounts. Operating as an embedded member of a regional sales pod, the GDR exercises independent judgment to own account engagement strategy across an assigned book of accounts, execute cohort sales plays in partnership with Marketing and Network Development, and lead buying-group qualification and discovery in support of opportunity creation. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.description_text: The Manager, Customer Engagement serves as a central architect for product Go-To-Market (GTM) execution, bridging the gap between technical product development and clinical application to maximize time-to-value. Operating with minimal oversight under the general direction of their leaders, the Manager is responsible for quarterbacking the end-to-end launch lifecycle for assigned product and program portfolios (such as Quality, Affordability, or Care Programs). This role requires a consultative and solution-oriented professional with a deep sense of curiosity to navigate ambiguous environments and make the unknown known. The Manager will actively utilize proprietary AI-driven workflow tools to scale enablement content, resolve complex roadblocks with creativity, and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure releases are completely field- and practice-ready. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $100,000 to $112,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Payer Enrollment Operations Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: Join a leadership team where your work directly shapes how Aledade’s physician practices succeed in value-based care. As Michigan Payer Enrollment Operations Manager (internally: Operations Manager, IPA), you’ll partner with IPA leadership to oversee the administrative engine behind our contracts, including payer contracts, contract membership, payment distribution, and client services delivery. You’ll collaborate across internal departments to help clients get the most out of pay-for-performance programs, risk sharing arrangements, and value-based contracts, and you’ll lead a team that may include an Operations Specialist and Membership Associates. Location Note: This is a remote role, with a strong preference for candidates based in Michigan due to the importance of understanding the state’s payer landscape and programs. Candidates located anywhere within the US will be considered. Salary Range: $90,000—$110,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle

A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Please note: candidates must be based in Florida area to be considered. Note on Travel: This is a primarily remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice (expected in the Florida panhandle). Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others.

jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, Analysts help turn careful laboratory work into reliable study support. jobs.title: Analyst II - DMPK
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them. In this role, you will support LC-MS/MS method validation studies and the analysis of biological samples. Our clients trust us to deliver excellence in data and bioanalysis, and this role is a key part of our project lifecycle. Working alongside a team of expert scientists, you will gain hands-on experience with sample preparation and LC-MS/MS instrumentation across projects involving small molecules, proteins, peptides, and/or biomarkers. Each project brings opportunities to build your technical skills and deepen your understanding of bioanalytical testing. The hourly pay range listed above reflects BioAgilytix's hiring range for this position.
